cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(cmp_android_media LANGUAGES C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
if(NOT ANDROID OR NOT ANDROID_ABI STREQUAL "arm64-v8a")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The qualified media bundle targets Android ARM64")
endif()
set(VENDOR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/vendor")
file(READ "${VENDOR}/manifest.json" MANIFEST)
string(JSON PROFILE GET "${MANIFEST}" profile)
if(NOT PROFILE STREQUAL "cmp-android-audio-1")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown Android media profile")
endif()
string(JSON COUNT LENGTH "${MANIFEST}" files)
math(EXPR LAST "${COUNT}-1")
foreach(INDEX RANGE ${LAST})
  string(JSON NAME MEMBER "${MANIFEST}" files ${INDEX})
  if(NAME MATCHES "(^/|\\.\\.|:|\\\\)")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid bundle path")
  endif()
  string(JSON EXPECTED GET "${MANIFEST}" files "${NAME}" sha256)
  file(SHA256 "${VENDOR}/${NAME}" ACTUAL)
  if(NOT EXPECTED STREQUAL ACTUAL)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Android media bundle hash mismatch: ${NAME}")
  endif()
endforeach()
foreach(NAME IN ITEMS avformat avcodec avutil swresample)
  add_library(${NAME} SHARED IMPORTED)
  set_target_properties(${NAME} PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${VENDOR}/arm64-v8a/lib${NAME}.so")
endforeach()
add_library(cmp_media SHARED src/cmp_media.c src/cmp_media_jni.c)
target_include_directories(cmp_media PRIVATE "${VENDOR}/include")
target_compile_options(cmp_media PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fvisibility=hidden)
target_link_options(cmp_media PRIVATE -Wl,--no-undefined -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384 -Wl,-z,common-page-size=16384)
target_link_libraries(cmp_media PRIVATE avformat avcodec avutil swresample)
